def score(item, bins):
    r = bins - item
    perfect = 1.0 - np.minimum(r, 1)
    t = r / 45.0
    t3 = t * t * t
    fit = 1.0 - np.exp(0.0 - t3)
    s = 5000.0 * perfect + (0.0 - r) + 40.0 * fit
    return s

def score(item, bins):
    residual = bins - item
    exact = 1 - np.abs(np.sign(residual))
    scores = 1000000 * exact - residual
    return scores

def score(item, bins):
    res = bins - item
    resf = res * 1.0
    s = np.where(
        resf == 0.0,
        1000000.0,
        np.where(resf < 45.0, resf, 500.0 - resf)
    )
    out = np.array(s, dtype=np.float64)
    return out
